_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Planet-name candidates, the role names that recur on every planet, and the four fighters' fixed home areas (docs/narrative/planet-and-homes.md). Unscreened by Legal; options for Orb, not canon. Claude-written.
same_name_reasons: It means home: the word for the fighters' world is the same in every language.
The stage rebuilds itself between seasons.
rule: One planet name every run, with the seed shown as a small number.
Role names recur on every planet and go to whichever place fills the role.
Everything else is named from the place-name grammar by the place's own seed.
Each fighter's home area has a fixed name.
Length, uniqueness, blocklist and no school, hospital or place of worship hold.
Same planet again replays the seed with the same names.

homes.name: Mendquay
homes.line: Same crooked plank. Same pier. Good to be home!

homes.name: Rankhold
homes.line: Everyone here knows exactly where they rank.

homes.name: Crownreach
homes.line: Our province, rat. Do mind the banners!

homes.name: Slagholt
homes.line: Smells like old steel. My favourite kind of lunch!

reserved: The polar outposts stay free as a set piece for a later fighter.
